title.en: Self-hosted image hosting — one leap to a link

subtitle.zh: imgli 是 Go 单二进制多用户图床，内嵌 React。支持本地/S3/WebDAV、机审、口令分享、管理后台运维台。v0.9.17 起官方 Docker 可收 iPhone HEIC。公共实例 img.li 供轻量试用（约 1GB 存储 / 5GB 月流量，非无限 CDN）；主路径是你自己部署。
subtitle.en: imgli is a single-binary multi-user image host in Go with embedded React. Local/S3/WebDAV, moderation, password shares, and an admin ops console. v0.9.17 official Docker accepts iPhone HEIC. img.li is a capped public trial (~1GB storage / 5GB monthly bandwidth — not free CDN); the main path is self-hosting.

description.zh: 前端 go:embed 内嵌；默认 SQLite，可选 PostgreSQL；无 CGO 亦可运行。
description.en: Frontend embedded via go:embed; SQLite by default, PostgreSQL optional; CGO-free builds.

description.zh: 本地盘、S3 兼容、WebDAV；策略级 CDN 302 卸带宽，私密图预签名。
description.en: Local, S3-compatible, WebDAV; per-policy CDN 302 offload and presigned private serving.

description.zh: 可插拔机审（NSFW + OCR 词表）、审核队列、用户组策略。
description.en: Pluggable moderation (NSFW + OCR keywords), review queue, group policies.

description.zh: 干净上传 API + Token；PicGo / ShareX / uPic / CLI 开箱。
description.en: Clean upload API + tokens; PicGo / ShareX / uPic / CLI ready.

description.zh: 管理后台「系统 / 运维」：doctor 健康检查、base_url / 反代错配提示、升级与清理入口。
description.en: Admin System/Ops: doctor health checks, base_url / reverse-proxy mismatch hints, upgrade & cleanup.

description.zh: 跨策略存储搬迁任务、版本探测与一键二进制升级（Docker 请换镜像）。
description.en: Cross-policy storage migrate jobs, version probe, one-click binary upgrade (Docker: redeploy image).

description.zh: Linux / macOS 用 install.sh 拉 v0.10.0 Release。详见文档「安装」。
description.en: Linux / macOS: install.sh pulls the v0.10.0 Release. See docs → Install.

description.zh: imgli serve 后打开本机端口；首位注册用户即管理员。生产请设 IMGLI_BASE_URL 为公网 https 源。
description.en: Run imgli serve; first registered user is admin. In production set IMGLI_BASE_URL to your public https origin.

description.zh: 设置 → API Token 按「三步接入」生成 Token，复制 PicGo / CLI 片段并试传。
description.en: Settings → API Token: follow three-step setup, copy PicGo / CLI snippets, upload a test image.

install.code:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yixian-huang/imgli/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- v0.10.0
imgli serve
# → http://localhost:8686

caption.zh: 完整安装、升级与配置见 docs.imgli.com；Docker：ghcr.io/yixian-huang/imgli:v0.10.0。
caption.en: Full install, upgrade, and config: docs.imgli.com. Docker: ghcr.io/yixian-huang/imgli:v0.10.0.

subtitle.zh: img.li 是限额公共实例（约 1GB / 5GB 月流）；文档在 docs.imgli.com；代码在 GitHub。商业授权咨询：yixian.huang.cn@gmail.com。
subtitle.en: img.li is a capped public instance (~1GB / 5GB monthly bandwidth); docs at docs.imgli.com; code on GitHub. Commercial licensing: yixian.huang.cn@gmail.com.
